reason: I'd download it and use the free 3 fragments a day, but I'm not starting a 'free 7 days' trial that turns into a charge. ELSA already did that to me, and the mic kept failing on top of it. Three a day is honestly enough for me to check whether it even hears me properly.
objection: It will crash or not pick up my microphone, and then I'll forget to cancel the trial and the App Store charges me for something that doesn't work.
would_change_my_mind: If it works without problems on the free tier for a week and the scores actually match my mistakes, and I can pay for just one month with no auto-renewal before my interview, then I'd take a month at $4.99.
